_comment: Template for the `workitems` block of `.claude/settings.json` (gitignored -- see .gitignore -- so nothing else ships a copyable starting point for it). Copy the `workitems` key below into your own `.claude/settings.json` (merge it in if that file already has other keys), then replace every placeholder with your own instance's values. See docs/adr/ADR-0005-claiming-runner-protocol.md for `claiming`. Leaving `provider` on "local" (CCPR's default, no server, no token) is also valid -- this template exists for the youtrack provider specifically, not to talk you into using it.
